certificate.title: Shop test certificate
certificate.explain: Phones and electronics need a test report from a phone or electronics shop. Take a photo of the paper: it must have the shop's stamp and show this device's brand, model and specs, dated within the last 30 days.
certificate.brandFirst: Choose the brand (and model) first: we check the report against them.
certificate.stale: You changed the device details. Check the certificate again.
certificate.missing: Add a shop test certificate that passes the check.

problem.unreadable: The photo is too blurry, dark or cut off to read.
problem.no_stamp: We couldn't find the shop's stamp.
problem.no_shop: The shop's name or phone number isn't on it.
problem.device_mismatch: The brand or model on it doesn't match this listing.
problem.no_specs: It doesn't list the device's specs (e.g. storage, RAM).
problem.already_used: This certificate is already on another listing.

checkout.locatedArea: We found your area from your location. Type the street, building and floor.

sales.empty: Nothing sold yet. When a buyer pays, the sale appears here.
